agreements.reason: Agree with rejecting UCI 360 for prototype N1 due to metadata contradiction on missing values (-200 sentinels), staleness (ends 2005-02-28), and single-site scope.
Agree with rejecting Chicago air quality data as unreachable (DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWLISTED) and outside Italy.

traced_conclusion.could_change_if: The dataset owner corrected the metadata and explicitly permitted non-research civic prototyping use, allowing UCI 360 to serve purely as a local code-prototyping sandbox.
